title: River Delta
concept: A distributary fan with several crossing fronts and contested delta islands.
difference_from_base: An explicit connected river graph that widens into delta islands, with planned wading or dry crossing corridors; not the Watershed drainage-noise family.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams up to 4v4, west versus east.
routes: Two to four reserved east-west crossing corridors span all river arms; amphibians can bypass the crossings.
economy: Mirrored land economy on mainland and delta islands; three fixed opening spots per side, general mex and geo controls.
known_weaknesses: Advanced crowding can merge arms and sacrifice island space.
Land validation profile; no promised fleet route through fords.
core_wishes: Requires the unchanged _wildlands.py helper from TPL-highlands-1.
